metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where Valorant said ‘Sure, take these freebies’ and I’m just vibin’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get gifted kills for doing nothing?
Enemy must've been on vacation or something.
Click if your aim checked out but the kills still rolled in!
Valorant logic is peak trolling again.

Tap if your best kills happen when you’re not even trying!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
